What is the Saints Car Show?

One day. Every kind of car. One cause.

The Saints Car Show is an open-format show hosted by the St. Augustine Car Club. Right on campus during school hours, so the whole community shows up. Rat rods, exotics, slammed builds, trophy trucks, anything with an engine and a story.

The St. Augustine High School Car Show has run for six years and has grown every time. Every dollar raised goes straight to the kids at Hogar Infantil La Gloria Orphanage in Tijuana.

Open to Every Build

Last year alone, we had a '63 Buick Riviera, a slammed '72 GMC Sierra, a Baja trophy truck, and a modified Porsche GT3 RS. If it has an engine and a story, it belongs here.

A Crowd That Shows Up

700 people packed the lot last year, full enough that this year the show is closing a street to make room. Students, families, and the whole North Park community, there for hours.

100% to Hogar Infantil La Gloria Orphanage

Every dollar goes to Hogar Infantil La Gloria Orphanage in Tijuana, which is an Augustinian children's home run by the same order behind the school. They take in kids facing abuse, neglect, or abandonment, and run entirely on donations with no government funding.

Who Your Support Reaches

Who shows up, and why it matters.

This is a day with real energy behind it. Exotics pulling in, a SWAT BearCat with a line of kids waiting to climb in, a full lot from open to close. Your booth is part of that, not background noise.

Sponsorship

Get involved your way.

No rigid tiers, no fine print. Every form of support lands in the same place, and makes the day better for everyone who shows up.

01

Make a Donation

Any amount goes directly to the kids at Hogar Infantil La Gloria Orphanage, and it's tax-deductible. Simple and direct.

02

Display Vehicles

Bring standout cars from your lot and put them on display for the 700+ attendees who are already there for the cars.

03

Set Up a Booth

Run a giveaway, share offers, or just meet the community. You'll have hours of face-to-face time with a captive audience of Saintsmen and members of our community.

04

Donate a Raffle Prize

Contribute to our 50/50 raffle. Your brand gets announced throughout the event with minimal effort on your end.

Category Sponsorship

Put your name
on a trophy.

These trophies aren't bought, they're donated, handcrafted by a Saints Alumnus. Made from stainless steel, water-jet cut, bent on a press brake, and powder-coated. Sponsor a category, and your name can go on the trophy the winner takes home and keeps forever.

At the end of the day, an Instagram post gets buried in the feed, and a booth gets taken down, but our trophies are forever.
